title: content/jobs/<job id>.yaml: one repair job, read top to bottom. job: the header. flow: the tutorial as a short outline, when the job has one. cards: the job's own cards, each once, in the order the flow first uses them.

item.description: A card id (the job's own card or a shared one in content/steps/), { procedure: id } for a shared sequence (content/procedures.yaml), or { inspect: id, outcomes } for a shared check (content/inspections.yaml).

flowItem.description: An item, or { branch } at a point where the ways differ: per way (flow.ways) the items for that way, an empty list for none. A branch names every way and holds no branch of its own.

id.description: The job's id, the same as the file name.

difficulty.description: Needed when the job has a flow.

choices.description: Run choices (content/choices.yaml) the tutorial asks before the start.

parts.description: Parts to have ready before the start (content/tools.yaml, parts).

covers.description: Which bikes this job covers, written once. Its tutorial and every diagnosis with covers_like this job read it. A bike outside when ends at the first not_covered entry that matches.

service.description: How often the job is due, for the garage's service light. Until a mechanic confirms the number, source is the placeholder <source, date> and the number is unverified.

source.description: Source and date, or the placeholder <source, date>.

price_eur.description: A range such as 20-35, or the placeholder <range>.

price_source.description: Source and date, or the placeholder <source, date>.

flow.description: The tutorial, in the user's order: the work, then the finish. Bikes outside the job's covers, or outside the flow's own covers, end before it.

covers.description: Which bikes the tutorial covers beyond the job's covers: what the user needs to do the job themselves (a shop still can). Read by the tutorial only, after the job's covers and before any way, so its facts are asked in the facts phase. A diagnosis with covers_like does not read it.

ways.description: Where the order of work differs (one branch by mechanism or by how the bike is held): each way's name and when. Evaluated top to bottom; the first match wins. Without ways the flow has one way and no branch.

work.description: The work, ending with the safety checks.

finish.description: Good path only: test ride, bed-in, success. Skipped after an exit.

cards.description: The job's own cards, each once, in the order the flow first uses them. A card used by more than one job, or by a procedure, goes in content/steps/.
